provenance.machine: Apple M1 Max, 64 GB, macOS 15, one thread
provenance.source: native kernel throughput ledger (independent drivers through each tool's API; minimum of three runs; uniform random points in the unit square and cube); implicit rows: external implicit comparison (meshing-call CPU of the fastest tool whose sampled distances meet the tolerance in both directions); recovery rows: CGAL CDT_3 on the ledger's icosphere and grid torus surfaces (the generators of this benchmark); refinement rows: Gmsh HXT generate(3) wall time, minimum of three, on the same generated surface given as a discrete surface with MeshSizeMin = MeshSizeMax = the mean surface edge (element counts within 1% of this benchmark's); surface remesh rows: the ledger's surface remeshing table, MMGS library time (MMGS_mmgslib) on the same generated surfaces with -hsiz h -hausd h^2/4; improve rows: MMG3D -optim -nosurf library time (MMG3DLIB elapsed, minimum of four runs interleaved with the row) on the TetGen inputs of benchmarks/native_meshing_mmg3d.py prepare (the ledger improvement inputs, byte-identical); MMG3D reaches minimum dihedral 21.97 / 19.29 / 19.74 degrees; the row targets these rounded up to 0.1 degree (minimum_dihedral_degrees); query rows: the ledger's F10 table, query throughput on its inputs (99,856-triangle torus, 930,942-tet sphere; 1e5 and 1e6 queries), acceleration-structure build excluded; layer rows: the ledger's F9 table (5 layers, first 0.01, growth 1.2, inward), the fastest valid reference per row on the same Gmsh surface meshes: Gmsh's whole classify + extrude + generate(3), else cfMesh's generateBoundaryLayers alone (its tetMesh untimed); the row times the larger scope, surface in to layers plus core out; metric rows: the ledger's F6b table, MMG3D library time (MMG3DLIB elapsed, minimum of three) on the same Gmsh cube and sampled targets
provenance.metric_rows: Gmsh 4.15.2 source banks regenerated with the ledger recipe: 3D cubes (10,452 / 98,932 / 965,817 tetrahedra, 2026-11-24) and 2D square (99,954 triangles, 2026-11-25, target h = min(0.0005 + 0.3 |r - 0.3|, 0.02) about (0.5, 0.5)). Every metric row ceiling is the faster of quiet single-threaded MMG 5.8.0 (mmg3d_O3 / mmg2d_O3) and serial Omega_h 9.34.13 on the identical byte-verified input digests, with allowed_ratio 1.0 on all ten rows (retaining the tighter 2026-11-24 MMG3D minima on the seven MMG3D-fastest 3D rows, tightening metric-3d-aniso 10000 and metric-3d-coarsen 10000 to serial Omega_h's 0.935 s and 0.1177 s, and registering metric-2d-iso 100000 at MMG2D's 0.345 s).
